title: Record the sum written into register 39 at the fault
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 24438, register 359 holds `1` and register 39 holds `-4` when register 359 starts at `1`. Their last writes are events 24433 and 24284.
- The fault addition multiplies register 359 by `4` and contributes `4`. The sum in register 39 is `0`. The data register contributes `0` to both operands.
- At the literal magnitude `256`, the operands are `256` and `-1024`, and the literal sum is `0`. No selected frontier change and no new exponent. Later changes of register 39 are not scanned.
